description: Moves a task: under a parent (subtask), after a sibling (previous), and/or into another list (destination_tasklist). Omitting parent puts it at the top level; omitting previous puts it first among its siblings — so calling with neither moves the task to the very top of its list. This is the ONLY way to change hierarchy or order (parent/position are read-only fields; positions are opaque strings maintained by the API). Constraints: parent and previous must be in the task's (destination) list; assigned tasks and recurrent tasks cannot be moved between lists. Returns the task with its new position.

destination_tasklist.description: Move the task into this other task list.

parent.description: New parent task id — the task becomes its subtask. Omit for the top level.

previous.description: Sibling task id to place the task after (same parent). Omit for the first position.

task_id.description: The task id — from list_tasks, get_task or create_task output.

tasklist_id.description: The task list id — from list_tasklists or create_tasklist output. "@default" addresses the user's default list.

name: move_task
title: Move a task
